source: GLM-5.3's MoE cut per expert at its TP8 statics (the circuit glm53-moe-per-expert): the router's slots, one output field a slot; each slot's w13 and w2 rows and scales read from tables registered one expert a row (EmbeddingRead_v1 at the leaf the router's committed slot index names); per-expert GEMMs over the rows read. Units a token are 75 layers x 8 slots on each of 8 ranks; ANDs and staged k_log as circuit-check reports them at those statics; output bits from each Definition's outputs (a read's h, H 16-bit words, and ok; a GEMM's N bf16 words). No proof_overhead card measures its types yet, so Figure 1 prices each at its staged k_log, computed, not measured. Its Definitions and circuit are built and circuit-checked per block type (in review); the cut is not yet proved or served, and the expert's binding is proved for the read's reference, not yet for its gates.
